CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMITTEE
  (NOTICE NO. N2M20-80)
  CORONAVRIUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE
Consistent with Executive Orders No. N-29-20 and No. N-35-20 from the Executive Department of the
State of California and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health Safer at Home Order,
the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee will not be physically open to the public and
will take place via video conference.
To watch and listen to the meeting: To maximize public safety while still maintaining transparency
and public access, members of the public can participate by using Zoom Meeting as follows:
Zoom Meeting direct link:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87936018230?pwd=c0p5Z01KUEVmNzl5bFFDWnNOZ29qZz09
Meeting ID: 879-3601-8230 and Password: 636852
For those wishing to speak on an agenda item, please e-mail Kelsey Rivadeneyra at
kelsey@cityofalhambra.org prior to the meeting with the item number you wish to speak on and your
name. You should then join into the meeting using
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87936018230?pwd=c0p5Z01KUEVmNzl5bFFDWnNOZ29qZz09 with Meeting
ID: 879-3601-8230 and Password: 636852 10 minutes prior to its start time. Ms. Rivadeneyra will
announce to you when it is your time to speak. You will have five minutes to speak, unless that time is
adjusted by the President.
As an alternative you can e-mail your comments by sending them to kelsey@cityofalhambra.org no
later than 5:00 P.M. on June 17, 2020 to ensure that it will be printed prior to the beginning of the
meeting. Comments will then be read into the record, with a maximum allowance of 5 minutes per
individual comment, subject to the President’s discretion. If a comment is received after 5:00 P.M. but
before the conclusion of the meeting based on its time stamp, the comment will still be included as a
part of the record of the meeting but will not be read into the record.
Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated should
e-mail or call Kelsey Rivadeneyra at kelsey@cityofalhambra.org or (626) 570-5044 who will use their
best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations to provide as much accessibility as possible while
also maintaining public safety. Given the challenges of video conference meetings, all participants are
encouraged to e-mail their comments prior to the beginning of the meeting.
  KELSEY RIVADENEYRA

  CLERICAL ASSISTANT II

minutes_text:
Unofficial until adopted by the  August 19, 2020
City Arts and Cultural Events Committee  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMITTEE
  Wednesday, June 17, 2020 7:00 P.M.
  Via Video Conference

The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Committee was called to order at 7:00
P.M. on Wednesday June 17, 2020 via Video Conference.

ROLL CALL
Committee Members Present: Canseco Chan, Luthi, and Zeller.
Committee Members Absent: Lawrence and Rutkowski.
Also attending: Director of Parks and Recreation Michael Macias, Deputy Director of Parks and
Recreation Brie Houghton and Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE OCTOBER 16, 2019 MEETING
On the motion of Vice President Luthi with a second by Commissioner Zeller, the minutes of the
October 16, 2019 Meeting were unanimously approved as written.

ELECTION OF OFFICERS FOR 2020/2021 TERM
Deputy Director Houghton informed the committee that the election will be held at the next
meeting when all committee members are present.

STAFF REPORT
Director Macias presented three renderings from the 2021 Tournament of Roses Parade Float
Design Student Art Contest to the committee asking for their input on selecting a float design.
After the committee reviewed and discussed the renderings, President Canseco-Chan moved for
a motion to approve an entry titled “The Education Bus” with a second by Vice President Luthi.
Commissioner Zeller recommended more Alhambra elements to be incorporated into the float
design such as the Alhambra Neon Welcome Sign or for wording along the bus to include
Alhambra.

Director Macias stated that Ted Slaught, the owner of the shops and theatre at the Renaissance
Plaza, had reached out to the City recently. Mr. Slaught wants to restore the decorative art
mosaics in the Renaissance Plaza at his cost. He will hire a local artist for restoration and wants
to install four additional large art pieces. Mr. Slaught wants to incorporate the City into updating
the area, have the City Arts and Cultural Events Committee involved with the grand opening and
would like to gift funds to the City Arts and Cultural Events Committee for new art in
Downtown Alhambra. President Canseco-Chan motioned to agreement for Alhambra City Arts
and Cultural Events Committee’s involvement and acceptance of funding. Seconded by Vice
President Luthi the motion carried by unanimous vote.
 PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
Angie Gomez expressed that she has been living in Alhambra since 1975 and has appreciated the
art in Alhambra over the years. Mrs. Gomez is curious to find out more information about the
Rose Parade Float as time progresses.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
Vice President Luthi will continue planning and preparing for 2021 Chalk Art Contest.

President Canseco-Chan would like to revitalize the downtown Alhambra district with murals
and create Alley Art behind the Main Street businesses. Canseco-Chan would like to see a
monthly art walk event similar to downtown Los Angeles or Monrovia’s art walk for the City of
Alhambra in the future. Vice President Luthi said he would help him anyway he could.

ADJOURNMENT
President Canseco-Chan moved to adjourn the City Arts and Cultural Events Committee Meeting.
Seconded by Vice President Luthi, the meeting was adjourned at 7:47 P.M.
